facts.name: Jenny S. Higginbotham
facts.assignment: Nassau County Court Division F; county civil/small claims and noncivil responsibilities.

contact.contact_note: Guide labels this address both physical and mailing. Office/assistant number shared; ADA fax is not a chambers fax.

chambers_communications.summary: Email assistant with case number, name and relevant matter; copy all parties. No unsolicited merits communications to judge.

hearing_scheduling.summary: For 15-minute county-civil/small-claims hearings, contact clerk904-548-4600, coordinate parties, then file/serve notice to secure time. For longer hearings, email assistant for availability, coordinate without assistant on the negotiation chain, and obtain confirmation. Motions must already be filed.

conferral.summary: Coordinate hearing availability with the other side before securing the hearing. The guide does not separately establish a universal merits-conferral rule.

proposed_orders.summary: Use linked Fourth Circuit proposed-order e-filing instructions; submit within ten days after hearing. Remote-appearance motions are a stated exception: notify assistant after filing without submitting a proposed portal order.

courtesy_copies.summary: Submit required case-law copies electronically, with voluminous copies by flash drive. Guide says hearing materials three business days beforehand, while courtesy/exhibit paragraphs say three days. Exhibits must not be emailed to assistant; consult source for delivery.

remote_appearances.summary: File motion and email assistant; request at least five days before hearing. Small-claims pretrial conferences are in person. Authorized Zoom appearances require legal name and video.

conflicts: General hearing-material paragraph says three business days; courtesy-copy/exhibit provisions say three days. Distinct wording retained without resolving timing.
gaps: No separately published personal judge email or chambers fax established; office uses assistant contact.

review_scope.collected: Six-page original/text, unchanged SHA256 from prior3650; prior review preserved.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Contacts and practical civil scheduling, communications, submissions and appearance paragraphs; relevant copy-routing qualification.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Criminal substance, particular litigation deadlines/strategies or linked forms; shared-order page applicability reviewed at county stage.
